title: HTTP Cache Freshness & Revalidation
description: Trace how the browser cache evaluates max-age, no-cache, ETag revalidation, and immutable assets.

steps.label: 1. Cache Key Lookup
steps.description: Browser hashes URL + Vary headers + top-level site partition key to check the disk cache.

steps.label: 2. Freshness Check (HTML vs Hashed JS)
steps.description: HTML uses no-cache (stale immediately); hashed JS uses immutable (fresh for 1 year).

steps.label: 3. Conditional 304 Not Modified
steps.description: Origin compares ETag; if unchanged, returns 304 with zero body bytes and resets freshness.
